capabilities: Append \tag{n} to display equations and renumber them on one-click update
Sync in-text cross-reference links when equation numbers change
Autocomplete equation reference links with ranked label candidates
Customize numbering formats globally or per note (chapter, prefix, sub-section styles)
Reuse numbers for duplicate equations via core LaTeX structure extraction
extras: Manually written \tag values inside display equations are overwritten when updating. The plugin rewrites \label{...} as % \label{...} to avoid MathJax parse errors, which is a rendering workaround. Bilingual English/Chinese documentation.
motivation: The author wanted to eliminate painful manual renumbering, broken cross-references, duplicate-equation number drift, and MathJax parsing errors when combining \label and \tag in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian offers no automatic numbering of display equations, so inserting or deleting an equation forces manual renumbering of \tag values and every in-text reference to them.
summary: Equation numbering plugin that appends \tag{n} to display equations, renumbers on demand, and syncs in-text cross-references with autocomplete.
